args.title: Triage issue #4413: update Toast.tsx
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Proposed change: address the reported issue in this file.
Evidence: The ToastProvider component in src/components/Toast.tsx implements a single toast stack container with aria-live="polite" where all toasts auto-dismiss after AUTO_DISMISS_MS (5000ms), whereas error toasts should be announced at once (e.g. aria-live="assertive") and stay until dismissed.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The ToastProvider component in src/components/Toast.tsx implements a single toast stack container with aria-live="polite" where all toasts auto-dismiss after AUTO_DISMISS_MS (5000ms), whereas error toasts should be announced at once (e.g. aria-live="assertive") and stay until dismissed.
